summary.intent: Run the GSD manager command center for CipherBox v1.1 milestone to discuss, plan, and execute three UAT-identified gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) sequentially from one terminal session.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 fully completed end-to-end (discussed, 8 plans created across 3 parallel waves, executed with worktree isolation, code-reviewed, verified against live DB, and marked complete). Phase 43 discussed and fully planned (4 plans). Phase 44 discussed (CONTEXT.md written); planning not yet started at transcript end.

repo: GSD branches per phase automatically: feat/api-unpin-integrity, feat/fuse-write-durability, feat/ipns-conflict-handling — main is never touched by the workflow.

Kubo runs with the 'server' profile (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72) which disables local-network discovery but keeps full public DHT participation — all pinned CIDs are broadcast as provider records and are publicly harvestable.
The POST /ipfs/unpin endpoint was protected by JwtAuthGuard only, with signup open — any account holder could supply a harvested CID and destroy another user's pin with no ownership check.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning (shared-write.ts:450), so there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path today.
BYO-IPFS unpin was broken in both directions (client-side provider.unpin not wired into delete flows); server-side fix makes it 'not pinned' advisory, swallowed automatically.
openapi.json gets reformatted as a side-effect of nest build — must git checkout -- before merge to avoid false merge conflicts.
The gsd commit helper (`query commit`) returns `committed: false` as a false negative while the commit actually lands — always verify with git log, never blind-retry.
pnpm --filter <pkg> test -- --testPathPattern=X is broken: pnpm inserts its own -- making jest treat the flag as a positional regex. Use pnpm --filter <pkg> exec jest --testPathPattern='X' instead.
.prettierignore did not exist; prettier was mangling .planning/ docs and GSD markdown, including breaking regex in table cells by treating pipe as a column separator.
Full monorepo test suites are RAM-constrained — always run targeted jest patterns in subagents and gates, never the full suite.

code.finding: Kubo v0.40 runs with the 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp). Server profile only disables LAN discovery — the node participates in the full public DHT and broadcasts provider records for every pinned CID.
POST /ipfs/unpin handler never read req.user — passed raw CID string straight to Kubo pin/rm with no ownership check. Fixed in Phase 42 to delegate to VaultService.guardedUnpin(req.user.id, dto.cid).

New guardedUnpin method uses pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) to close the concurrent-unpin refcount race, transactional row-delete + refcount + pending_unpins outbox insert, then best-effort Kubo pin/rm post-commit. Emits cross-user audit metric on no-row miss.
Upload compensation path called global Kubo pin/rm directly — could unpin a CID that content-addressed dedup shares with another user. Fixed to route through guardedUnpin.
Web unpin calls .catch(logger.warn) — unpin errors are swallowed silently, so the silent-2XX decision for the no-row case matches existing consumer behavior.

New BullMQ WorkerHost with drainPendingUnpins (calls provider.unpin per row, error-isolates, publishes gauge) and runDriftReport (NDJSON parse of Kubo pin ls output, read-only — zero .delete( calls in drift path).

FUSE release handler calls into IPFS without persistence — on crash after FUSE ack but before remote commit, data is lost with no recovery path. Phase 43 addresses this with a persist-backed WriteQueue.
Existing SDK queue facility examined as the basis for Phase 43's persist-backed WriteQueue; op-log enum (UploadFile|MkdirPublish) will journal-fsync-before-ack with ciphertext-only entries.

workflow: Worktree cleanup-wave helper must be run from the repo root — running it from inside a worktree directory causes false base_mismatch errors because it resolves repoRoot from cwd.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun. Write a reduced manifest containing only remaining unmerged entries for retry.
Remove node_modules and .husky/_ untracked dirs from agent worktrees before running cleanup-wave, otherwise the helper aborts the entire batch on first blocked entry.
1Password SSH signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git commit calls. On signing failure ('agent returned an error'), ask user to restart 1Password — never use --no-gpg-sign.
Decision coverage gate uses literal grep for 'D-NN:' citation strings in plan must_haves sections — plans must include explicit decision citation lines, not just implement the decision.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed mid-session requiring the user to restart the 1Password app before commits could resume.

gsd commit helper returned 'committed: false' as a false negative multiple times while the commit actually landed, wasting time on blind retries before the 'always verify with git log' rule was established.
Planner agent died with a socket error after writing plans 01-03, requiring a filesystem check and continuation planner spawn.
cleanup-wave cwd bug: running from inside a worktree produced false base_mismatch errors on all entries, requiring a full restart from repo root with a new manifest.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD in a conflicted-but-auto-resolvable state; git commit --no-edit was needed to conclude it, then manual worktree remove + branch -D.
openapi.json formatting drift (564+ lines, formatting-only) from a nest build side-effect needed git checkout -- before wave 3 merge.
prettier was mangling .planning/ documents before .prettierignore was created — a regex testPathPattern in a VALIDATION.md table was split into columns by the pipe character.
User explicitly called out that the assistant was re-presenting menus instead of answering questions directly: 'you did not answer my question, just presented the same answers for me to choose from'.
Two instances of accidental user keyboard input ('touring wyatt web bossy') during long-running agent waits interrupted the session flow.
Session hit the context limit mid-code-review gate, requiring a summary-based continuation.
